arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import pandas as pd

file_path = 'data/housing_dataset_chatgpt.csv'
try:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    print('--- Shape ---')
    print(f'Rows: {df.shape[0]}, Columns: {df.shape[1]}')
    
    print('\n--- Column Names ---')
    print(list(df.columns))
    
    print('\n--- Data Types ---')
    print(df.dtypes)
    
    print('\n--- Missing Values ---')
    print(df.isnull().sum())
    
    print('\n--- Summary Statistics (Numeric) ---')
    print(df.describe())
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
"
